about: Edgeville (Edgeville piece step 1): the bank's four bankers, the grange's seven men, and the rats, giant spiders and imps round the town. Types and tiles are mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live, 2026), checked against the 241 cache's types and the OSRS Wiki's Edgeville page (four bankers, seven men). Every wander range is guessed until recorded. Step 2 added the General Store's keepers, Perdu upstairs, Oziach, Richard and the six guards by the ditch (guard1, whose combat and drops are the Varrock piece's). Step 3 added Doris, Hari and Lucien, and Evil Dave and his hell-rats in the Basement of Doom below Doris's house. Step 3b added the ten outlaws in their camp south-east of the town, and step 4 the monastery's six monks (mejrs saw six; the Wiki says five), Abbot Langley and Brothers Althric and Jered. The and the Wilderness's NPCs come with their own steps.
